claims.statement: Production prices come from the active App Store or Google Play offering; unavailable offerings do not display invented prices.
Trial copy is shown only when the store reports the selected product as eligible.
Reminders require permission and are scheduled locally; a denied permission does not produce a success state.
Journal, progress and preferences remain on-device; deleting local data preserves purchases and downloaded content.
Every released Scripture edition is integrity-checked and retains edition-specific source and rights evidence.
